answer.reason: The verses tell of Othniel taking Kirjathsepher and delivering Israel from Chushanrishathaim, which go beyond the relations and office in the summary.

clauses.quote: Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it

clauses.english: delivered Israel from Chushanrishathaim king of Mesopotamia
clauses.quote: the LORD delivered Chushanrishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand

doubts: 1CH 27:15 'of Othniel' names a family or clan of Heldai, not this man, so it was left out.
His death (JDG 3:11) is not given as a clause.
